The authenticated caller, derived from verified Clerk JWT claims.

Claims only — there is no domain user record yet (case ownership is M2).
CurrentUser.title: CurrentUser

ImportRowValueResponse.description:
The normalised values of a valid row, echoed back so the validate preview shows
exactly what would be imported (dates canonicalised, country code upper-cased).
ImportRowValueResponse.title: ImportRowValueResponse

RouteSupportResponse.description:
The route-support decision. Carries the composite outcome and each upstream
requirement outcome so the UI can explain *why* — provenance, not just a verdict.
RouteSupportResponse.title: RouteSupportResponse

TravelRecordInput.description:
A manual travel entry. `date_confidence` and `review_state` are independent
(§11.4, §11.5) and default to EXACT/CONFIRMED — a user entering a trip is asserting
it — but can be downgraded to make an uncertain record visibly distinct.
TravelRecordInput.title: TravelRecordInput
